name: What features should I add to a luxury custom Jacuzzi?

mainEntity.name: Which features actually matter in a luxury custom Jacuzzi, and which ones are just expensive extras?
mainEntity.text: Which features actually matter in a luxury custom Jacuzzi, and which ones are just expensive extras?

acceptedAnswer.text: Luxury Jacuzzi projects should start with performance, not accessories. The most important features are efficient heating, well-placed jets, durable waterproof finishes, comfortable seating, and a filtration system that is easy to maintain. Once those basics are right, homeowners can add lighting, automation, water features, premium tile, and custom controls. The problem with many luxury builds is that they look impressive but are hard to service or inefficient to run. In high-end Los Angeles neighborhoods, buyers often want a spa that feels integrated with the architecture rather than a decorative add-on. The best features depend on how the spa will be used. For therapy, jet placement and ergonomics matter most. For entertaining, lighting and spillover design may matter more. For resale, timeless materials and clean integration usually outperform flashy options. The right contractor should help prioritize features based on use, not just upsell expensive add-ons.
acceptedAnswer.description: The most valuable luxury Jacuzzi features are efficient heating, strong but controllable jets, comfortable seating, reliable filtration, quality waterproof finishes, and easy service access. Extras like lighting, water features, and automation add appeal, but only if the core system is well designed.
